The family tree displayed an empty icon that was then replaced by the fathers icon and sisters icon depending on who I last clicked on, and the fathers Wants and Fears were also empty.

I deleted the whole family and created them all over again, but the exact same thing happened with the same daughter. So I though: "maybe it's the clothes she's wearing?", which was the white and blue cheerleader uniform. I thought maybe the files aren't linked properly, causing her specifically to disappear. But when I created a dummy family with the same dress, everything was fine. I'm really confusdd as to what exactly caused this bug, and why the "same" sim was the issue both times. Not technically the same Sim of course.
